Adding or removing staff

Accounts are managed in Supabase. To add someone: invite them under Authentication → Users, then insert a row into public.admin_profiles with their user id (is_admin = true, is_active = true). To remove access, set is_active = false — the dashboard signs them out on their next page load. Passwords and MFA are enforced by Supabase Auth.
